Attach the Fold Lab trace (fold timing, no personal data)

• The motion is the wallpaper's own. It cannot control Samsung's screen switch animation or the lock screen animation.
• If the new screen appears more than 3 seconds after folding (for example inside another app), the end state is shown without motion.
• One UI may keep separate wallpapers for the cover and main screens. Fold Lab records how this phone behaves.
• Packs are drawn by an on-device illustrator, not an AI model. Cloud generation and the community gallery are not part of this version.
No account, no internet permission, no analytics. Descriptions are used only while generating; the pack keeps a hash, not the text. Packs stay on this phone unless you share them.

No events yet. Apply a pack, go to the home screen, then fold and unfold the phone.

1. Apply any pack.
2. Go home, close the phone, wait 2 s, open it. Repeat 20 times slowly and 20 times quickly.
3. Repeat from the lock screen and with Power saving on.
4. Export the trace and attach it to the POC report with the build number above.

The scene will use these colours from your photo.
The photo is read once on this phone to take its main colours. It is not saved, copied or uploaded, and the scene is not drawn from its content.
This photo could not be read. Try another one.
Unfold the phone and the scene opens with it. Fold it and the light gathers back.
Between folds, stars twinkle, light drifts and the layers breathe. It pauses when the screen is off, in power saving and with reduced motion.
Near layers follow the phone gently as you tilt it.
Tap a style to try it on this wallpaper. It plays when you open and close the phone.
Picks a style that suits the scene, so your wallpapers don\'t all move alike.
The scene opens from the right, where the closed phone was, out to the left, with light on the moving edge.
The left half swings down flat in 3D like a page, from right to left, as the phone opens. On the outer screen the scene swings shut like a door.
The scene wakes from the dark and its layers rise into place one after another, with embers floating up.
A jump out of light speed: stars streak past and the layers fly in from close up.
The scene assembles from tiles flipping over in a wave from right to left. On the outer screen they flip row by row.
A band of light crosses the screen from right to left and the scene appears behind it.
Light gathers at the focal point, then the scene opens from it in a circle.
A drop lands on the focal point: rings spread out, bending the picture like water, and the scene appears with them.
The scene pours across the screen from right to left like thick liquid, with a glossy, wavy edge that bends what is under it.
The scene comes into focus behind melting glass: frosted and refracting at first, then crystal clear.
Couldn\'t change the animation. The wallpaper is unchanged.
Start delay with the screen on

When you fold or unfold with the screen on, One UI plays its own switch animation first. The fold animation waits this long so it is not over before you can see it. If it starts too late or is half gone, try another value.
It reacts to your phone: tilt it and the liquid drifts downhill, tap the home screen for ripples, half-open the phone and it pools along the fold. Touch the preview to try.

Pick a photo of a person, a pet or a car: the app finds the subject on your phone and lifts it in front of the background, so it moves in 3D when you tilt the phone and rises out of the picture when you unfold it. Nothing is uploaded.
